info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Logistics Shipments Exceptions-v5-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Exceptions API provides valuable insights into any exceptions encountered during the handling of logistics shipments. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of exceptions that have arisen in the logistics process, facilitating proactive management and resolution. Typical consumers include logistics managers and support teams who need to monitor shipment integrity and address issues promptly. Enhance your operational efficiency by utilizing this API to track and address logistics challenges effectively.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed information about shipment exceptions. You can use this to monitor and manage issues related to shipments.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving shipment exceptions, formatted in JSON. This request allows you to specify criteria for filtering the exceptions. Ensure that the JSON payload complies with the expected schema to receive the appropriate response.

200.description: Request processed successfully, returning the exception shipments.
